changes.title: Review bodies
items: Six animals reshaped after Ed's review: the polar bear carries its head low on a longer neck over a high shoulder, the unicorn stands tall on long legs with a horse's head, the badger has shoulders and a waist and a wedge of a head, the rhino's horn grows with it and its young is its own, the crocodile's wide flat jaws show their line and its legs splay out, and the snow leopard has longer legs, a thicker tail and big paws

changes.title: Trollwood palette
items: The Trollwood's trees are a touch less grey

changes.title: One off growth
items: Frost trolls, hedgehogs, armadillos and crabs change as they grow: a troll's first tusks and moss, a hoglet's soft spines, an armadillo pup's soft pink shell, a crab's claws growing with age
